name: example-percy-plugin-cypress
description: Cypress + Lumina demo app for the Percy Visual Testing plugin's integrate / expand-coverage skills. Starts with NO Percy.

scripts.percy: set -a && . ./.percy/.env && set +a && CYPRESS_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5599 NO_PROXY=localhost,127.0.0.1 percy exec -- start-server-and-test 'http-server site -a 127.0.0.1 -p 5599 --silent' http://127.0.0.1:5599 'node scripts/cypress-run.mjs'
